description: Put photos, scans and screenshots (JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP…) into a single PDF, in the order you want and without losing quality. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 1 per page.

files.description: Input files (.bmp, .gif, .jfif, .jpe, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .tif, .tiff, .webp). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

margin.description: Margin Values: 'no' = No margin; 'pequeno' = Small; 'grande' = Large

size.description: Page size Values: 'a4' = A4; 'carta' = Letter; 'imagen' = Same as the image

name: jpg_to_pdf
title: Convert JPG to PDF
